report.text:
Bootstrap check passed: ruleset 0.7.0+claude.20261008194106.da20519d loaded · Project agent-pipeline (self-application) · Calibration not opened (forbidden surface, not needed) · State briefing TR-J-T2c-20261009 · Role Goldfish

Route pre-check: field 6 requests claude-sonnet-5-5 / xhigh (agentType goldfish-deep) and declares no ARCHITECTURE/GUARDRAIL/SECURITY class. This dispatch's runtime prompt names the model claude-sonnet-5-5. Requested and observed agree; no mismatch.

Status: implementation complete; independent review: pending; PO acceptance pending. This is a completed run, NOT a closing-allowance handover: the 80 percent hook notice fired at call 44, but all work was already done and committed, and no stop condition fired (about 48 of the 55 counted tool uses).

1. DoD results
- 1. Native capture: passed. 79 tests, 73 pass, 0 fail, 0 cancelled, 4 skipped, 2 todo. The three (A) cases (unattested origin, rejected observation, F4(b)) pass. The two (B) cases skip with the typed reason OWNER-RUNTIME-LINUX-ONLY. The new null-ownerRuntime case passes. The other 2 skips are T2b's pre-existing SYMLINK-EPERM cases, not this slice's. Arithmetic against the T2b baseline (78/69/5/2/2): 69 + 3 repaired + 1 new = 73 pass.
- 2. WSL capture: passed. 79 tests, 77 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, 2 todo. 0 new skips; both (B) cases RAN and passed on Linux (76 + 1 new = 77).
- 3. node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: passed, 9 tests, 9 pass, 0 fail. The exit code was not captured to an artifact: the tool returned the TAP output with no error, and node --test exits non-zero on any failure. I did not claim a machine-written exit code for it.
- 4. One commit of the test file only: passed. 1e8ac9d8f546391dcf1ef9107a0ec254f6d3473f, subject exactly as briefed, exactly the two trailers (Dispatch: TR-J-T2c-20261009 (goldfish) and AI-Assisted: true), no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session. git add -- <file>, then as a separate call git commit -F scratch/commit-msg/TR-J-T2c.txt -- <file>. git show --name-only lists exactly one file.
- 5. Terminal record: this file, written after the commit.

2. Evidence
- evidence/TR-J-T2c-20261009/native.txt. Command: node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/TR-J-T2c-20261009/native.txt --label native -- node --test plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/pipeline-start-preflight.test.mjs. exitCode 0 at line 3, counts at lines 87-93, typed (B) skips at lines 74-75, SYMLINK-EPERM skips at lines 54 and 80.
- evidence/TR-J-T2c-20261009/wsl.txt. The same capture command in the form wsl.exe -e bash -lc "cd <repo root under /mnt>; ...", label wsl. exitCode 0 at line 3, counts at lines 87-93.
- node --check on the edited file: exit 0, run before the captures.
- git show --name-only --format on HEAD: one path, two trailers.

3. Changed files
- plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/pipeline-start-preflight.test.mjs (commit 1e8ac9d8f, +69 -3). (a) preflight() helper: new default requireProjectOnboardingReadyFn returning the ready stand-in, placed BEFORE ...options so a caller's own fn still overrides it. (b) F4(b) case: the identical stand-in passed to its direct observePipelineStartPreflight call. (c) New constant OWNER_RUNTIME_LINUX_ONLY_SKIP_REASON next to SYMLINK_EPERM_SKIP_REASON, naming localProcessStartIdentity, /proc and the backlog item 2026-10-09-concurrent-session-warning-never-fires-on-native-windows. (d) Both PHX-WP-AAC01-MULTISESSION owner-runtime cases get the options-form skip: process.platform !== "linux" ? reason : false. (e) One new case, "a descriptor with a null ownerRuntime never warns; status/nextAction never change", before the no-descriptors case.
- Uncommitted by design: evidence/TR-J-T2c-20261009/native.txt, evidence/TR-J-T2c-20261009/wsl.txt, evidence/dispatch-record-TR-J-T2c-20261009.json, scratch/commit-msg/TR-J-T2c.txt.

4. Deliberately not changed
- No assertion was removed or loosened and no expected value changed. No case other than the two (B) cases was skipped; no whole-file or describe-level skip.
- Caller audit for the helper default: the case that asserts the plain ready nextAction (inspect --intent bootstrap) calls preflight() without its own fn. It now sees the stand-in instead of the real gate and still yields bootstrap, because the stand-in never throws so sessionReadinessNotReady stays false (production line 1640). The cases that assert onboarding behaviour (onboarding-init action, PORG-NOT-READY) already pass their own fn and keep overriding. The WSL run is the confirmation: no previously green case turned red on either host.
- The .processStartId dereference in the not-live/reused/unavailable/unobserved case (the reason it throws natively) is untouched; it is Linux-only and now sits behind the typed skip.
- Production files, other tests, hooks/, lib/guard/, harness/, the calibration file: not touched. Foreign staged and dirty files in the shared tree were not staged.

5. Deviations from spec
- F4(b) never routes through the preflight() helper: it calls observePipelineStartPreflight directly, with no requireProjectOnboardingReadyFn and no checkCloneProvisioningFn. The briefing diagnosis attributed its red to the helper, so the helper default alone could not repair it. I injected the identical stand-in at its own call site: same fix, same mechanism, a different injection site, expected values unchanged. Without that, F4(b) would have stayed red (stop condition 1 as worded). This is a briefing-vs-repo mismatch resolved in favour of the briefed intent; it needs the Elephant's or Critic's eye.
- The new positive case is modelled on the first MULTISESSION case's before/after skeleton and on the descriptor-rewrite technique of the not-live fixture, rather than on the two later cases the briefing named. It uses the same buildConcurrencyRepoFixture() and writes ownerRuntime: null explicitly, so it is host-independent and runs on both hosts instead of merely observing Windows behaviour.
- Process notes without effect on the result: the first Write was refused (GUARD-BOOTSTRAP-RECEIPT-MISSING) until the preflight ran from the loaded plugin root; a relative-glob Glob and a glob Grep were refused (GUARD-READ-TARGET) and not retried around.

6. Open items
- Independent Critic review: pending. PO acceptance: pending.
- The two (B) cases are exercised only under WSL on this machine; native Windows skips them by typed reason. Backlog item 2026-10-09-concurrent-session-warning-never-fires-on-native-windows stays open (production defect, not a test fault).
- resultSha256 stays null: for an authored-commit record the binding is the commit.
- The F4(b) injection-site deviation above needs a reviewer's decision.
